data.desc: CNH (NYSE: CNH) serves and advances the people who feed and build a growing world. We are an iron-and-tech company, engineering intelligence, automation, and precision into the machines that move the global economy. Our equipment operates in more than 160 geographies, supported by a global team of more than 34,000 people, including engineers, technologists, and industry experts. Our brands - Case IH, New Holland, STEYR, CNH Tech (including the Raven precision technology platform), and CNH Capital - together generated $18.1B in revenue in 2025. Building on a legacy of innovation dating back to 1842, CNH has achieved multiple milestones including the first mass-produced tractor, the first twin-rotor combine, and the first factory-integrated precision farming system. Today, we are engineering autonomous and predictive machines that will shape the future of food and infrastructure.
